states.noMatchesBody: Try a different search, or widen the status filter.

decision.notePlaceholder: Why you are approving or rejecting this
decision.noteHint: Required when rejecting — it is the only thing the applicant is shown. Optional when approving.
decision.reasonRequired: A reason is required when rejecting.
decision.alreadyDecided: This has already been decided. It is here so you can see what was done.

dashboard.queuesBody: Every state change here writes an audit row, and two admins working one queue is normal — the counts refresh after each decision.
dashboard.partnerTemplates: {count} of the live templates were built by partners.

events.title: Events
events.description: Public events awaiting moderation. Approving lets the event appear in Explore.
events.search: Search by title, organizer or location
events.emptyBody: New public events will appear here as organizers create them.
events.gatesDiscovery: This decision controls public discovery only. A rejected event keeps its own page, its share links, its registration and its invitations — it is removed from Explore, not taken down.
events.draftHint: The organizer has not published this yet, so nothing is waiting on you. Reviewing a draft usually means deciding on a page that may still change.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Partner designs awaiting review. Approving publishes the template.
templates.search: Search by name or author email
templates.emptyBody: New partner designs will appear here as they are submitted.
templates.noPreview: This template has no preview image.
templates.author: Author

listings.title: Listings
listings.description: Vendor listings awaiting review. Approving publishes the listing as written below.
listings.search: Search by title, vendor or email
listings.emptyBody: New vendor listings will appear here as they are submitted.

partnerRequests.title: Partner requests
partnerRequests.description: Applications for a partner account. This is the only route to one outside Django admin.
partnerRequests.search: Search by business, email or phone
partnerRequests.emptyBody: New partner applications will appear here as they are submitted.
partnerRequests.grantsFlag: Approving grants partner access to this account. To remove it later, clear the flag in Users.
partnerRequests.reapplyLabel: If you reject, may they apply again?
partnerRequests.reapplyHint: The middle option is the default 30-day cooling-off period. This only applies to a rejection.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Activation payments awaiting confirmation. Check the proof against the amount and the reference.
payments.search: Search by reference, email or event
payments.emptyBody: New activation payments will appear here as they are submitted.
payments.noProofBody: No proof of payment was attached to this one.
payments.cascade: Confirming also creates the commission, enables the event's template and records any promo use. None of that needs a second step, and none of it can be undone here.

commissions.title: Commissions
commissions.description: Referrer payout claims. This queue opens on claims that have actually been requested.
commissions.search: Search by reference, referrer or event
commissions.emptyBody: Claims appear here once a referrer asks to be paid out.

creditOrders.title: Credit orders
creditOrders.description: Partner wholesale credit purchases. Approving issues the credit code.
creditOrders.search: Search by order reference, partner or transaction
creditOrders.emptyBody: New wholesale orders will appear here as partners place them.
creditOrders.mints: Confirming issues a credit code. It can only happen once — a second attempt is refused rather than issuing a second code, so do not retry a confirmation that appears to have failed.
creditOrders.ownPartnerScope: This pack is restricted to the partner's own approved designs. Its code will be refused on system templates and on other partners' work.
creditOrders.issuedHint: Worth {count} credits. The partner will ask for this — it is not shown again.
creditOrders.copyFailed: The code could not be copied. Select it and copy it by hand.

users.title: Users
users.description: Account lookup, and the three flags staff may change.
users.search: Search by email, name or phone
users.emptyBody: No accounts have been created yet.

is_partner.label: Partner
is_partner.hint: May buy credit packs and activate templates with them.

is_verified.label: Verified
is_verified.hint: The account's identity has been checked.

is_active.label: Active
is_active.hint: Turning this off blocks the account from signing in.

users.notePlaceholder: Recorded in the audit log alongside the change
users.historyTitle: Recent admin actions on this account
users.saveFailed: The flags could not be saved.
users.noChange: Nothing changed — those flags were already set that way.

actions.title: Audit log
actions.description: Every decision made here, in order. Read-only — nothing can edit or remove a row.
actions.search: Search by actor, target or note
actions.emptyBody: Decisions will appear here as they are made.

catalogue.fileKept: Leave this empty to keep the current file.

music.title: Background music
music.description: The tracks an organizer picks from. A new track is live immediately.
music.emptyBody: Add a track and it appears in the organizer picker straight away.
music.name: Track name
music.fileHint: MP3, OGG, M4A or WEBM, up to 20 MB.
music.durationHint: Nothing measures this for you, and the showcase sizes its player from it.
music.activeHint: Turning this off removes the track from the picker. Events already using it keep playing it.
music.orphanWarning: Deleting this leaves these events with no music, and nothing tells their organizers.
music.deleteWarning: This cannot be undone. Retiring the track instead keeps it working for anyone already using it.
music.deleteWarningUsed: {count} events are using this track. Deleting it leaves every one of them silent, and nothing tells their organizers. Retire it instead.

fonts.title: Fonts
fonts.description: The shared type library, including every partner upload.
fonts.search: Search by name, uploader or licence
fonts.emptyBody: Add a typeface and it appears in the template picker straight away.
fonts.name: Font name
fonts.fileHint: TTF, OTF, WOFF or WOFF2, up to 5 MB. The metrics are measured from the file.
fonts.uncalibratedHint: The file could not be measured, so this face will render at the wrong size against the rest of a template until the metrics are filled in.
fonts.metricsHint: Leave blank to let the server measure the file. Anything you type is kept as typed, which is how a bad measurement gets corrected.
fonts.activeHint: Turning this off removes the font from the picker. Templates already using it keep it.
fonts.orphanWarning: Deleting this leaves these templates without their typeface.
fonts.ownershipNote: A font added here is curated by staff. Ownership and source are set by the server, so there is nothing to choose.
fonts.deleteWarning: This cannot be undone. Retiring the font instead keeps it working for any template already using it.
fonts.deleteWarningUsed: {count} templates are using this font. Deleting it leaves every one of them without its typeface. Retire it instead.

icons.title: Agenda icons
icons.description: Inline SVG markup, used on agenda items.
icons.emptyBody: Paste some SVG markup and it becomes available on agenda items.
icons.name: Icon name
icons.svgHint: Pasted markup is cleaned before it is stored and drawn. Use currentColor so the icon takes the colour around it.
icons.svgInvalid: Nothing in this markup can be drawn. Check it is a complete SVG element.
icons.previewEmpty: Paste some markup to see it here.
icons.deleteWarning: This cannot be undone, and agenda items using it will fall back to no icon.

plans.title: Pricing plans
plans.description: What a template costs and what a partner earns on it.
plans.emptyBody: A plan sets the price for every template assigned to it.
plans.name: Plan name
plans.commissionHint: Applies to future payments only. Commissions already created keep the rate they were made at.
plans.featuresHint: One per line. These appear on the pricing card in the order you write them.
plans.bestSellerHint: Highlights this plan on the pricing card. Presentation only, it changes no price.
plans.activeHint: Turning this off hides the plan from checkout. Templates on it keep their price.
plans.repriceWarning: Changing the price changes what every template on this plan costs.
plans.repriceWarningLong: {count} templates are on this plan. Changing the price changes what all of them cost, immediately.
plans.deleteWarning: This cannot be undone. Retiring the plan instead hides it from checkout without touching the templates on it.
plans.deleteWarningUsed: {count} templates are on this plan. Retire it instead of deleting it.

categories.title: Event categories
categories.description: The categories events and templates are filed under. Anyone can create one, so this list needs tidying.
categories.search: Search by name, description or creator
categories.emptyBody: Categories organise events on Explore and in the template catalogue.
categories.name: Category name
categories.userMadeHint: Created by a user rather than curated by staff.
categories.activeHint: Turning this off hides the category from pickers. Events already in it stay in it.
categories.orphanWarning: Deleting this uncategorises these events, and nothing tells their organizers.
categories.deleteWarning: This cannot be undone. Retiring it instead hides it from pickers without touching the events in it.
categories.deleteWarningUsed: {count} events are in this category. Deleting it uncategorises every one of them. Retire it instead.

team.title: Team
team.description: The people shown on the public About page.
team.emptyBody: People added here appear on the public About page.
team.name: Name
team.orderHint: Lower numbers come first on the About page.
team.showOnAboutHint: Turning this off removes them from the public page without deleting the record.
team.deleteWarning: This cannot be undone. Hiding them instead keeps the record and takes them off the public page.

applications.title: Applications
applications.description: The hiring pipeline. Moves are recorded, and there is no fixed order.
applications.search: Search by name, email or position
applications.emptyBody: New applications appear here as they arrive.
applications.privacyNote: This is personal data, and the notes below are private to the hiring team. Every move you make here is recorded.
applications.noteHint: Kept with the audit record. The applicant never sees it.
applications.noChange: No change, it was already in that state.
applications.moveFailed: That move could not be saved.
